claim: After the linear change of variables given by 'basis' (rows: phi(X_i) = sum_a basis[i][a] X_a, entries in the stated field), the cubic relation ideal has a finite Groebner basis in the Dp order (degree, then X_1 > X_2 > X_3) whose head words are exactly 'head_words'. The number of words of degree n with no factor in 'head_words' equals the coefficient of z^n in 1/(1-3z+3z^3) for every n (both sequences satisfy linear recurrences of bounded order, so finitely many degrees settle the comparison; 'proper_prefixes' is the number s of proper prefixes of the head words, the empty word included). Hence the relations are strongly free and the 3-class tower group of the field is mild of cohomological dimension 2.
